contract.task_clause:
What is the enlightened self-interest model of CSR?
Option A: That it is in an organization's own best interest to put itself first rather than its ethics
Option B: That it is in an organization's best interest to consider what a shareholder would want
Option C: That it is in an organization's own best interest to act in an ethical way
Option D: That it is in an organization's own best interest to follow the legislation and abide by the law
